description: Canonical replacements applied by normalise() in R/normalise.R, after the tidy data target. dimension_names maps a raw dimension name to its canonical name; values maps, for each canonical dimension name, a raw label to its canonical label. Names are renamed before labels are mapped. Anything not listed is left as it is. First version generated from the data: footnote markers and extra spaces removed from all labels, en dashes in year ranges, and synonyms for state, sex and indigenous_status.
